skill.name: AgentDB Vector Search
skill.description: Build semantic vector search workflows with AgentDB for document retrieval, similarity matching, and RAG knowledge bases.
skill.summary: Implement AgentDB vector search for embeddings, hybrid queries, RAG retrieval, and Claude Code MCP workflows.
skill.author: ruvnet

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, CLI examples, local database filenames, and reference links. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or hidden execution was found in SKILL.md. Users should still review community CLI commands before running them.

remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed AgentDB version in examples and tell users to inspect package changes before running commands.

remediation.issue: MCP setup examples use npx to start a remote package.
remediation.suggestion: Document manual approval and version pinning before registering the MCP server in Claude Code.

remediation.issue: Sample database paths can be copied into real projects.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that .db and .sqlite examples should be created in a test workspace without secrets.

content.value_statement: Teams need fast semantic retrieval without designing vector storage from scratch. This skill guides AgentDB setup, embedding storage, similarity search, and RAG retrieval workflows.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to initialize AgentDB vector databases with different embedding dimensions.
Provides CLI examples for similarity queries, thresholds, metrics, import, export, and statistics.
Demonstrates TypeScript adapter setup for embeddings, metadata, and reasoning retrieval.
Explains RAG context retrieval patterns with Maximal Marginal Relevance support.
Covers quantization choices, HNSW indexing, caching, and basic troubleshooting.
limitations: Requires AgentDB or agentic-flow packages to be available in the project environment.
Requires an embedding provider, such as OpenAI or a compatible local model.
Does not provide production access control, backup policy, or data retention guidance.
Performance claims should be verified with project data and hardware.

use_cases.title: Prototype RAG Search
use_cases.description: Create a small semantic search database for documentation, support articles, or internal notes.

use_cases.title: Tune Retrieval Quality
use_cases.description: Compare similarity thresholds, distance metrics, and MMR settings for a retrieval workflow.

use_cases.title: Expose Search Through MCP
use_cases.description: Connect AgentDB search tools to Claude Code for interactive project knowledge retrieval.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Database
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for local semantic search.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up an AgentDB vector database for my project documents. Use the right embedding dimension and explain the first query I should run.

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a RAG workflow using AgentDB. Include document storage, embedding creation, retrieval settings, and answer generation with cited context.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Search Relevance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my AgentDB semantic search configuration. Recommend threshold, metric, metadata filters, and MMR settings for better result quality.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production plan for AgentDB vector search. Cover indexing, quantization, monitoring, backups, access controls, and benchmark validation.

output_examples.input: I need semantic search for 5,000 support articles.
output_examples.output: A setup plan with embedding dimensions, local database initialization, document storage steps, and a first similarity query.

output_examples.input: My vector search returns many near-duplicate passages.
output_examples.output: A tuning checklist that raises the threshold, enables MMR, reviews metadata filters, and tests result diversity.

output_examples.input: I want Claude Code to query my project knowledge base.
output_examples.output: A Claude Code MCP setup outline with AgentDB server registration, tool usage notes, and version review guidance.

best_practices: Pin AgentDB package versions before running CLI or MCP setup commands.
Keep embedding dimensions consistent between stored vectors and query vectors.
Benchmark retrieval quality and latency with representative project data.
anti_patterns: Do not store secrets or regulated data in sample vector databases.
Do not mix embeddings from different models in the same index without migration.
Do not trust benchmark numbers until they are reproduced in your environment.

faq.question: Does this skill install AgentDB automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and implementation guidance that a user or agent must review before running.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require an OpenAI API key?
faq.answer: It needs an embedding provider. OpenAI is one option, and custom embedding models can also be used.

faq.question: Can it support metadata filtering?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes hybrid search examples that combine vector similarity with metadata filters.

faq.question: Is it ready for production security controls?
faq.answer: No. Teams must add access control, data handling rules, backups, and monitoring for production use.

faq.question: Can it connect to Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes MCP server setup guidance for using AgentDB tools in Claude Code.
